title: Nike’s Spring Sale is Slashing Prices On Dunks, Jordans and NBA Gear Up to 50% Off
summary: Save big on fan-favorite Nike sneakers, apparel and accessories for the warmer months ahead.
contentText:
All products and services featured are independently chosen by editors. However, Billboard may receive a commission on orders placed through its retail links, and the retailer may receive certain auditable data for accounting purposes.

Spring is here and Nike is slashing prices across fan-favorite sneakers, sports apparel and accessories. If you’re looking to upgrade your wardrobe and and sneaker rotation without breaking the bank, Team Check is currently running a rare up to 50% off sale bursting with impressive markdowns for shoppers to save big entering into the spring season.

Shop classic Nike Dunk shoes , WNBA merch , Nike Tech apparel , transparent stadium bags and the popular Air Jordan 1 mid sneaker . Shoppers can save up to 50 percent on a wide range of Nike, Jordan and LeBron products on the brand’s site. To give you hand, we’ve rounded up the best Nike deals to snag before the sale is over.

Best Nike Sneakers Deals

Looking to add new sneakers to your spring rotation? There are plenty of Nike, LeBron and Jordan favorites receiving price cuts going into the warmer months. Shop fan-favorite sneakers like the Dunk, Air Max and AJ1 Mid up to 49% off almost right now.

Nike Dunk Low Next Nature Sneakers

$80.97 $120 33% off

Buy Now on nike

Brighten up your Spring wardrobe with these “elemental pink” Dunk lows.

Nike Air Max Excee Sneakers

$69.97 $100 30% off

Inspired by the iconic Air Max 90, the Excee model delivers a modern twist to a classic silhouette with elongated design lines and distorted proportions.

LeBron NXXT Genisus Sneakers

$85.97 $170 49% off

Want to perform like LeBron James? His NEXXT sneaker line focuses on combining advanced technology and sleek aesthetics to enhance your game. With lightweight, supportive mesh and flexible Air Zoom cushioning, you’ll be dropping MVP numbers with ease.

Nike LD-1000 Sneakers

$63.97 $105 39% off

What was once designed for long-distance runners in 1977, has now become a fan-favorite everyday shoe. Shop one of Nike’s most famous designs for almost 40% off.

Air Jordan 1 Mid Sneakers

$106.97 $140 24% off

Inspired by the iconic Air Jordan 1, this mid-top edition maintains the classic look (and colorway) with a crisp leather upper, stitched-down Swoosh and a Jumpman logo on the tongue.

Best Nike Clothing Deals

If you have been eyeing Nike’s popular tech fleece apparel, its currently 31% off. There’s also great shorts, sweatshirts and even basketball apparel on sale. Shop our favorite pieces like the all-over print Michael Jordan bottoms and the “everyone watches women’s sports” t-shirt to add to your wardrobe this spring.

Nike Tech Woven Reflective Jacket

$120.97 $175 31% off

Nike’s popular tech jacket receives an ultra-reflective makeover to help your outfit stand out.

Nike "Everyone Watches Women's Sports" T-Shirt

$35.97 $50 28% off

The message on the shirt says it all. Support the WNBA with this fiery orange graphic tee, which is currently 28% off.

Nike Sportswear Woven Flow Shorts

Show off your legs this spring/summer with these breezy, mesh lining and lightweight shorts.

Nike Club Fleece Loose Crew

$31.97 $60 47% off

For the love of the game, add this cozy crew sweatshirt to your wardrobe for almost 50% off.

Jordan Flight Woven Pants

$88.97 $125 29% off

Make yourself like Mike by literally wearing the “GOAT” with these bold, all-over print pants.

Nike Swoosh Dri-FIT French Terry Pullover Fitness Hoodie

$46.97 $75 37% off

A simple yet effective hoodie for the transitional spring weather.

Best Nike Accessory Deals

Complete your outfit with these discounted, stylish accessories. Upgrade your sunglasses, tote bag, hats and even a transparent stadium bag that’s currently 40% off. There’s no better time to add some fun accessories to your spring and summer look.

Jordan Stadium Bag (1.7L)

$23.97 $40 40% off

An affordable stadium bag with a thick, durable and transparent design equipped with an “university blue” adjustable strap. There’s also a 2-way zipper closure making it easy to retrieve items on the go.

Nike Tech Bottle Carrier

$39.97 $60 33% off

During festival season, keep your water bottle secured with this versatile crossbody bag made of durable, water-repellent ripstop material and an insulated pocket.

Nike SB Club Skate Cap

$24.97 $32 22% off

A great, everyday 6-panel cap you can rock to the skate park and beyond.

Nike Veil Prism Sunglasses

$130.97 $169 23% off

Fashion meets sports in these unique Nike shades blending innovative design with style. The Veil Prism shades feature “Nike Max +,” which helps reduce light reflection and provides precise vision from all angles.

Jordan Icon Tote Bag (32L)

$92.97 $135 31% off

Featuring the brand’s signature allover woven elephant skin pattern, this tote feels like wearing your Jordans around your shoulder. The zippered main compartment houses a laptop sleeve and an inner zippered pocket, which helps secure smaller items you don’t want lost in the shuffle of the main compartment.
